en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਮੰਝਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਅਪਤੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: teerath ma(n)jh nivaas hai bagulaa apateenaa|

en.bdb: Crane though living at a pilgrimage centre remains without faith.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਵੈ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਵਰਸਦੈ ਜਲ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਪੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: lavai babeehaa varasadhai jal jai na peenaa|

en.bdb: The rain-bird goes on crying during rain but dries not know how to drink water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਂਸ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਪਰਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaa(n)s suga(n)dh na hoviee paramal sa(n)g leenaa|

en.bdb: Bamboo may be engrossed in sandalwood but cannot take its fragrance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਰਮਾ ਦਾ ਹੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: ghughoo sujh na sujhiee karamaa dhaa heenaa|

en.bdb: So unfortunate is owl that it never beholds sun.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਦੇ ਵਤੈ ਓਡੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: naabh kathooree mirag dhe vatai oddeenaa|

en.bdb: Though musk remains in the el of deer, yet it goes on running around in search of it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲੈ ਮੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu muh kaalai meenaa ||1||

en.bdb: The true Guru is true emperor and the faces of the dissemblers are blackened.
